finding: Bounded relation-aware ClayGraph expansion is part of the preprocessor line that reached 1.00 required-evidence recall and 1.00 top-1 intended affordance on the synthetic 10-query/400-distractor fixture versus 0.8833/0.30 for flat lexical retrieval. Graph access paths remain rebuildable derived topology, not truth.
negative_boundaries: stale graph/source epoch rejects fast path
counterhypotheses: Dynamic or materialized graph expansion may amplify stale/wrong edges.
Synthetic graph relations may be unusually aligned with the benchmark labels.
On-demand lexical/dense retrieval may match quality at lower rebuild cost on real snapshots.
next_gate: Held-out real-snapshot comparison of materialized ClayGraph V3 fastpath vs bounded dynamic one-hop graph vs no-graph lexical/dense baselines, including stale-epoch and edge-lesion cases plus rebuild latency/memory.
ancestry_policy: ClayGraph V3 and the possibility-preprocessor benchmark are one coordinated lineage, not independent replication.
